title: Organization transition request (committed under .stegverse/transition-requests/)
description: DRAFT, candidate 9. Derived from the 9 committed requests at StegVerse-org/.github@10d14104, the workflow shape asserts (organization-ledger-transition.yml L116-122), resident-runtime/manifest_directed_run_inputs.py (committed_manifest, transition_mesh_root) and org-boundary/runtime/node_standing.py (standing modes). A request is a manifest-directed input; it carries no authority. The ingress decides the disposition, and the organization ledger records it either way.

request_id.description: Must equal the file basename without .json (all 9 committed requests follow this).

mesh_root.description: Durable mesh locator git+<repository>#refs/<name>. Every request of one run that declares one must declare the same one.

build_manifest.description: Arguments for the pinned SDK's stegverse.manifest_builder.build_manifest. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

manifest.description: The exact, already-built manifest. Requires expected_canonical_manifest_sha256.

mode.description: A standing mode of the canonical node ingress contract (docs/CANONICAL_NODE_INGRESS_CONTRACT_001.json). modes[0] is genesis (ESTABLISH_GENESIS in every committed request).

predecessor.description: null only for explicit genesis; otherwise the predecessor fields required by the contract. The key must be present (predecessor-key-absent is FAIL_CLOSED).

hb_epoch.description: PROPOSED addition (closes InTr FC-7 for push-triggered request mode): the supplied heartbeat epoch this request's receipts carry. A push carries no dispatch input, so the epoch travels in the committed request. No clock fallback.

x-stegverse-outcomes.ALLOW: shape valid; the request is built or verified, received on the organization ingress (an InTr-owned interface), and its disposition is appended to both ledgers
x-stegverse-outcomes.DENY: an unsupported standing mode, or genesis declaring a predecessor (node_standing). The refusal is recorded on the ledger with six fields.
x-stegverse-outcomes.FAIL_CLOSED: both or neither manifest form; a committed manifest whose digest does not reproduce; a missing standing key; a request path outside .stegverse/transition-requests/; an uncommitted request. Nothing is appended.
